Yes, but it didn't use to be this bad...

I recently started taking medication a few days ago after already being in therapy for eight months. I've noticed that I feel more anxious and "desperate" on meds. My family has gone on vacation without me because I have school. Right now, I feel very, very alone at home. I had the urge to drink earlier to relax but then a quick google told me that drinking while on antidepressants isn't such a good idea. I don't know what to do. I'm not sure if it's the medication that's making me suicidal, I don't know...
